proposed_widenings.name: Condition: incapacitated
proposed_widenings.justification: The failure branch applies the Incapacitated condition. The Condition type only contains 'prone'. Encoding the failure branch requires widening Condition to include 'incapacitated'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, you take 6d6 Psychic damage and have the Incapacitated condition until you finish a Long Rest.

proposed_widenings.name: DcSource: fixed_dc
proposed_widenings.justification: The saving throw is against a flat DC 15, not the caster's spell save DC and not a weapon_attack_dc formula. Neither existing DcSource variant represents a fixed numeric DC.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you cast this spell, make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw.

notes: The spell's core purpose is an oracle: the caster mentally contacts an entity and can ask up to 5 questions; the DM answers each with one word. This is pure DM adjudication with no deterministic mechanical resolution — legitimately dm_agenda. The failure branch (save + damage + condition) has secondary mechanical content but two surface widenings would be required to encode it: a fixed_dc DcSource variant and 'incapacitated' in the Condition type. Even with those widenings, the success branch remains unrepresentable in-core.
